messages:
jenna-release: FYI I cut RC: v2.3.4-rc4 from branch release/v2.3 this morning. artifacts at s3://ci-artifacts/redwood/v2.3.4-rc4 (sha: a1b2c3d). planning promo to prod in the 18:00-19:00 UTC change window. please ack and flag any blockers.

mike-qa: smoke and regression quick pass done on staging (kv warm, api surface). 3 flaky tests but unrelated to serving. sample: 200/200 text gen smoke ok.

sam-sheriff: taking sheriff for the window. i want a pinned rollback artifact and the rollback playbook linked here before promo. also please confirm canary % and telemetry asserts.

jenna-release: noted. rollback artifact pinned as a1b2c3d-rollback (kept in the same S3 bucket). rollback steps in PR comment and ops runbook. canary planned at 10% for 15 minutes -> 50% for 30m -> full, with kill-switch. telemetry asserts: 95th latency < 250ms, tok/cost within 5% of baseline, error rate < 0.1%.

lina-eng: quick note: this build uses the updated kv-cache warming script; recommend running kv-warm job on canary hosts 10m prior. config snippet below:```bash
./kv_warm --model v2.3.4-rc4 --hosts canary-set --prefixes-file /tmp/top-prefixes.txt
```

mike-qa: i already ran kv_warm on staging, looks good. also ran evals on the small prompt-set: no regressions > 2% on quality metrics.

tao-oncall: i'm oncall for the window, available 18:00-20:00 UTC. give me a ping at roll when you start.

jenna-release: deploybot, please pin artifact and schedule canary at 18:05 UTC, promote if telemetry green. include rollback hook and label release_notes: v2.3.4-rc4.

deploybot: Pinning artifact a1b2c3d-rc4 -> pinned_by=jenna-release at 2025-10-10T16:45:00Z. Scheduling canary: start=2025-10-10T18:05:00Z, steps=[{"pct":10,"dur":"15m"},{"pct":50,"dur":"30m"},{"pct":100,"dur":"0m"}], rollback_cmd="/ops/rollback --artifact a1b2c3d-rollback --force". (Note: bot messages are compacted) :ping_pong:

sam-sheriff: approving promo on my side, conditional on: 1) docs-bot confirms release notes posted, 2) deploybot snapshot shows rollback artifact pinned and smoke metrics hook present.

docs-bot: Release notes draft published at https://docs.internal/releases/v2.3.4-rc4. Short changelog: improved KV warming, kernel selection fix for long seqs, bugfix: streaming reconnect. I'll update the public digest after final promo.

jenna-release: ok we're green on the checklist. starting canary at 18:05 UTC. will post telemetry links as they stream. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Canary started: job_id=cb-prod-canary-8812. Targets: canary-set-1..4. KV-warm job executed 10m prior. Telemetry dashboard: https://telemetry.internal/d/abc/canary-8812

mike-qa: canary 10% first 5m looks stable. latency median ~ 38ms, 95p 190ms, errors 0.03%. leaving a +1.

jenna-release: promoting to 50% now. tagging release_notes:final-draft.

deploybot: Promotion step: 50% applied. Auto-checkers running. If any regression triggers, will auto-rollback to a1b2c3d-rollback.

tao-oncall: seeing slight spike in retries on node canary-set-3, flipping it out of rotation to isolate. continuing watch.

sam-sheriff: ok to proceed with full promo once 50% completes cleanly for 30m.

deploybot: 50% window complete, no triggers fired. Applying 100% cutover. Finalizing.

jenna-release: final promo complete. prod-tag: v2.3.4 (rc4 promoted). release_notes published. big thanks everyone. :party_parrot: 

mike-qa: quick post-check: run health-checks and search index sanity. all green from our side.

sam-sheriff: closing thread. rollback plan remains in runbook if needed. good job. :shipit:
